title: Cosmic Voyager
description: A tall, hooded cosmic entity with a swirling vortex for a face and a glowing yellow eye stands in a wooden boat on a stormy sea. It holds a glowing green lantern in one hand and a swirling orb in the other, its cloak and head composed of vibrant, flowing aurora-like patterns of purple, green, and pink against a dark, lightning-filled sky.
prompt: A surreal cosmic entity with a single large eye in a swirling green and purple vortex head stands aboard an old wooden boat named 'AETHERIS' on a turbulent dark sea. The figure wears a flowing dark cloak and holds a dripping green lantern in one hand and a glowing orb in the other. Its body and head are made of vibrant swirling aurora patterns. Dramatic stormy sky with purple lightning and glowing green and purple northern lights above, bioluminescent waves below, dark fantasy style.
